says: The last of the pencil, maybe a few strokes. Taking the final note: I draw the traveller first, with a few fine hatch strokes down the side away from the light, then the same scene again, pod, stalk, leaves, rock and horizon, unchanged. No sharpening: the sharpener alone would eat what is left before a line went down, so the point is allowed to thicken as it goes. By the preview this page leaves only a sliver of pencil above the mark.
